result.summary: Scope test: ran `git diff main...HEAD -- scripts/test_parallel.sh`. The diff is entirely confined to scripts/test_parallel.sh, a dev/CI test-tooling shell script. It adds a `cleanup_tmp_dir` function registered via `trap ... EXIT` that removes the script's own per-run mktemp scratch directory (partition create/migrate + test logs) on a clean (exit 0) run, unless TEST_PARALLEL_KEEP_LOGS is set, and preserves it on any nonzero exit. It does not add/modify an API route reading or writing tenant-scoped data, does not add/modify a priv/repo/migrations/*.exs migration, does not resolve or handle any secret (no config/env/token access -- only $tmp_dir, $TMPDIR, TEST_PARALLEL_KEEP_LOGS, an ordinary boolean env-var check), does not add/modify response-shaping code for a tenant-scoped entity, and does not add/modify a lookup-by-ID handler. Verdict: OUT OF SCOPE -- no tenant-data path touched. Per-invariant verdicts: INV-1 (tenant data isolation) NOT-APPLICABLE -- no Ecto schema/migration/business-table query touched. INV-2 (server-side field authorisation) NOT-APPLICABLE -- no API response type touched; also pre-S4. INV-3 (untrusted runtime sandboxing) NOT-APPLICABLE -- pre-S5, no scripting/plugin code touched. INV-4 (secrets by reference only) NOT-APPLICABLE -- no secret material (API key, webhook signing key, OIDC secret, DB URL) is read, logged, or serialised anywhere in the diff; confirmed by inspection, the only env vars touched (TMPDIR, TEST_PARALLEL_KEEP_LOGS) are non-secret config knobs. INV-5 (not-found/forbidden indistinguishability) NOT-APPLICABLE -- pre-S4, no lookup-by-ID endpoint. INV-6 (new data-access paths prove scoping) NOT-APPLICABLE -- no new data-access path introduced. INV-7 (no SQL string interpolation) NOT-APPLICABLE -- no SQL, no Repo.query call, shell script only. INV-8 (no unhandled crashes on realistic failure paths) NOT-APPLICABLE -- this invariant targets lib/letflow/ Elixir code touching external I/O/tenant data; this diff touches only a bash test-runner script's own tmp-dir lifecycle, not Elixir process/supervision code. INV-9 (tenant-controlled outbound URL validation) NOT-APPLICABLE -- no outbound HTTP request or URL handling in the diff. No BLOCKER issues found.
